summary: Tower in Richland County that the state's 1938-39 report appears to list as 'Blythwood'; marked removed on Eastern US Lookouts. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Eastern US Lookouts marks the tower Removed, with no date given.

events.note: The state report for July 1938 to June 1939 says new steel was erected at Blythwood. Year given is the one the report period ends in.

evidence.supports: The Civilian Conservation Corps built towers and telephone lines that year at no cost to the state or protective associations
evidence.quote: Additional towers and telephone lines were constructed by the Civilian Conservation Corps at no cost to the State or protective associations.

evidence.supports: New steel was erected at the site, spelled Blythwood in the report
evidence.quote: New steel was erected at Blythwood.

evidence.supports: TopoQuest lists a Blythewood Lookout Tower in Richland County at 488 feet elevation
evidence.quote: Blythewood Lookout Tower is a tower located in Richland County, SC at N34.202372° W80.982588° (WGS84/NAD83) and at an elevation of 488 ft MSL.

evidence.supports: Eastern US Lookouts marks the Blythewood tower as removed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1938-39 state report spells the site Blythwood; TopoQuest and the brief use Blythewood. Treated as one site on name match and because the TopoQuest coordinates (34.202372, -80.982588) match the brief. The report gives no coordinates, so this link is an inference.

notes_for_editor: Only the Eastern US Lookouts page supports the build and removal facts (it quotes the state report, not read directly). The TopoQuest entry gives a location and elevation only; it is a map feature with no date or condition. Identity with the 1938-39 'Blythwood' entry rests on the name and the coordinates. A WBAJ-AM broadcast tower in Blythewood (TopoQuest 1252315, N34.095152 W81.063703) is a different structure and is not used. Firetower Road street names are not evidence and are not used. A 2018 Blythewood brush-fire article is unrelated to the tower and is not used. No staffing, access, visit or fire data found. Search budget was spent, and the page reads were largely exhausted.
